legend_toml:
# Drafted from the 5 placeholder(s) in a Word template. Check each type,
# add descriptions and defaults, and add [[scenario]] tables as needed.

[[var]]
name = "CLIENT_NAME"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "INVOICE_NO"
type = "string"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "STATUS"
type = "enum"
values = ["part_paid"]
required = true

[[var]]
name = "BALANCE"
type = "money"
currency = "GBP"
required = true

[[var]]
name = "PAY_BY"
type = "date"
required = true
template:
![Image 1](1-image1.png)

# Account statement

Dear {CLIENT_NAME},

Invoice {INVOICE_NO} for the joinery at your home is **overdue**.

{?STATUS="part_paid"}

Thank you for your part payment. The balance now due is {BALANCE|plain} pounds.

{:}

Please pay the full amount by {PAY_BY|long}.

{/}

| **Item** | **Amount** |
|---|---|
| Invoice {INVOICE_NO} | {BALANCE} |

If anything here looks wrong, call us on 07700 900123.
